title: Two Stories, One Lantern Festival
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试，也不对应任何官方分数。请先听/读对话，完成8道听力理解题；然后学习语法讲解并完成8道语法题；最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. You look tired. Were you waiting for me?
Ben: Yes, I was. I was standing near the gate for twenty minutes. While I was waiting, I watched the lanterns.
Mia: Sorry! My grandmother was telling me a story about this festival. She says the lanterns are for a clever girl who saved our village.
Ben: That's interesting. My neighbor told me a different story. He says the lanterns are for a brave man who fought a dragon.
Mia: Really? Which story is true?
Ben: I don't know. Maybe both stories are old. People tell different stories about the same tradition.
Mia: My grandmother's story is about a girl who made a big fire on the hill. The fire helped travelers who were lost in the dark.
Ben: My neighbor's story is about a man who carried a lantern to the top of the hill. He wanted to warn people about a dragon that was coming.
Mia: Hmm. Both stories have a hill and a light. Maybe they are the same story, but people remember different parts.
Ben: That's possible. While we were talking, the sun went down. Look, people are lighting the lanterns now.
Mia: The lanterns are beautiful. Which one do you like best?
Ben: I like the red one that is shaped like a fish. What about you?
Mia: I like the small white one which is hanging near the tree. It looks like a star.
Ben: Do you think the stories matter?
Mia: Yes. The stories are the reason we come here every year. They connect us to the past.
Ben: You're right. Next year, I will ask my neighbor more questions. Maybe he knows more about the girl story too.
Mia: Good idea. And I will ask my grandmother about the dragon story. Maybe the two stories will become one.

grammar.title: 过去进行时入门；when / while；who / which / that 定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某个时间正在进行的动作，结构是 was/were + 动词-ing。常与 when 或 while 连用：while 后常接进行时，表示“在……期间”；when 后常接一般过去时，表示突然发生的动作。定语从句用 who 指人，which 指物，that 既可指人也可指物，放在名词后补充说明。注意：本课新学过去进行时和定语从句；一般过去时是复习内容。
grammar.example: While I was waiting, I watched the lanterns.

questions.prompt: While she ______ dinner, the phone rang.
questions.explanation: while 引导的从句表示正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 was cooking。
questions.evidence: While I was waiting, I watched the lanterns.

questions.prompt: They ______ football when it started to rain.
questions.explanation: when 从句表示突然发生的动作，主句表示正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 were playing。
questions.evidence: While we were talking, the sun went down.

questions.prompt: I saw a man ______ was carrying a lantern.
questions.explanation: 先行词 man 指人，定语从句用 who。
questions.evidence: My neighbor's story is about a man who carried a lantern to the top of the hill.

questions.prompt: This is the lantern ______ is shaped like a fish.
questions.explanation: 先行词 lantern 指物，定语从句可用 that（或 which）。
questions.evidence: I like the red one that is shaped like a fish.

questions.prompt: While I ______ for the bus, I met an old friend.
questions.explanation: while 从句表示过去正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 was waiting。
questions.evidence: While I was waiting, I watched the lanterns.

questions.prompt: She was reading a book ______ her brother was watching TV.
questions.explanation: 两个动作同时进行，用 while 连接两个进行时从句。
questions.evidence: While we were talking, the sun went down.

questions.prompt: The girl ______ saved the village is very clever.
questions.explanation: 先行词 girl 指人，定语从句用 who。
questions.evidence: She says the lanterns are for a clever girl who saved our village.

questions.prompt: The story ______ my grandmother told me is very old.
questions.explanation: 先行词 story 指物，定语从句用 that（或 which）。
questions.evidence: My grandmother's story is about a girl who made a big fire on the hill.
